title: In plain words
summary: A short, non-technical reading of each finding: what was observed, what it does not show, and what to do next.

paragraphs: Every finding in the inbox and in the post-ingest brief has an In plain words button. It opens three short statements: what was observed, what it does not show, and what to do next.

sections.heading: What it does not change
items: The basis label, the confidence meter and the citations are unchanged, and stay visible whether or not the explanation is open.
The explanation never decides whether a finding is a legal claim. That comes from the finding kind, as it does for the basis label.
A pattern signal is described as a reason to look. It is never described as an accusation, a violation or a legal conclusion.

sections.heading: Verification states
paragraphs: Each verification state has the same three statements. A slower-than-peers result is explained as a comparison with other agencies, with no statute involved. Only a counted comparison is explained as one.

sections.heading: An evidence gap is not a finding
paragraphs: A gap says a check could not be run for lack of records. It is never explained as a result, and never as a sign that an agency did or did not comply.
